item.text: The current provider combines all setup logic in `PassAliasesProvider.tsx`, assumes a vault always exists, and its bridge factory creates one implicitly inside `getDefault`. That conflicts with the required no-vault empty state and explicit creation flow. I’m checking the modal form and bridge call sites before splitting the provider into the requested hook.

item.text: The requested hook and helper are now in place. The hook treats “no vault” as a completed empty state, creates a vault only when the user starts the form, and refreshes both the alias list and quota count after creation. I’m tightening imports/types and checking the focused UI tests and PassBridge type usage next.
